'''Jem's''' was a building that was located in the settlement [[Dalia (township)|Dalia]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dalicron-4]], during the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jem]] made beverages in it and it also had a large orchard behind it.
